decision: review of PR 12 (merged as 5c06240) on branch ui/harbor-review in worktree berth-ui
why: the overhaul landed; this pass looks for what its own gates cannot see
evidence: git log origin/main -1 = 5c06240 Harbor UI overhaul (#12)

decision: both gates green on the merged tree before any change
why: so every later failure is mine
evidence: check.py 75 pass, overhaul.py 57 pass against 127.0.0.1:9795

decision: wrote a throwaway probe for what the gates do not measure: target sizes, font sizes, live regions, DOM churn per poll, jump-button geometry, dialog key scoping, failed-read states
why: an audit before a redesign needs numbers, not impressions
evidence: /tmp/audit.py plus a MutationObserver churn count

decision: engine cards lost #11's offline styling in the merge: engines.js emits "offline", the rewritten CSS only styles ".down"
why: a never-started engine showed the word OFFLINE in the same green as a live engine
evidence: merged build on 9793: state colour rgb(126,224,163); after the fix rgb(118,135,153)

decision: the log's ALL chip toggled the filters but never repainted, and never updated its own pressed state
why: with one chip off, ALL left the rows hidden until the next event arrival, and the incremental path then misordered them
evidence: measured: 21 rows -> 6 -> 21 in the same tick; gate "the rows come back in event order"

decision: the log's steady-state path scanned the board for every row it removed: O(n^2) with an array allocation per row, every poll
why: the plan promised no per-render allocation
evidence: the loop is gone; a missing row now forces one rebuild instead

decision: keys fired while a dialog was open: pressing 2 behind the ticket switched tabs
why: the page must not move under the operator
evidence: while the ticket was open: engines tab visible True -> False

decision: LATEST was position:sticky inside a non-scrolling wrapper: it overlapped the log's first row and pushed the note down 32 px
why: appearing must not move the page
evidence: now absolute in the log's corner: inside=True, shift=0.0px

decision: a failed /v1/storage left the storage panel shimmering forever with no text
why: loading shimmer with honest empty states was the plan's own claim
evidence: now "the harbor could not read its store" plus RETRY; gate: no shimmer left

decision: collapse buttons built "fold the null panel" for a panel without aria-label
why: an unlabelled control is a defect either way
evidence: falls back to the panel id

decision: the departures board was itself aria-live="polite" with 200 flapping tiles inside it
why: polite announcements of the whole board on every state change
evidence: the board is not a live region; its foot (role=status) names the count and the order

decision: the alert strip was role=status with role=alert children: every alert announced twice
why: one region per message
evidence: the strip is the region, the cards are content

decision: the conn and state pills are live regions rebuilt every 3 s with a moving relative age
why: an announcement every poll, forever
evidence: rebuilt only when the state changes; the age is aria-hidden and ticks in place; gate: 0 element mutations over 8 s

decision: screen readers were told nothing about state that only color carried: the rail's active pill, the board's sorted column
why: WCAG 1.4.1 and 4.1.2
evidence: aria-current on the rail, aria-pressed on each sort head

decision: focusable charts without a name: the machine trend charts and the KV pool line
why: role=img plus tabindex with no accessible name
evidence: all four are named; gate "every focusable chart is named"

decision: the odometer is role=img: the reels are hidden and the name said "counter", never the number
why: the number is the panel
evidence: the name carries it: "collisions avoided: 12,847"

decision: no skip link; the header, the alert strip and a nine-item rail stand between Tab and the content
why: first-stop link to main, and main takes focus
evidence: gate: the skip link shows on focus and lands on #main

decision: phone targets below the floor the overhaul set for itself: alert dismiss 16 px, board sort heads 19 px, the rail 30 px, the log prompt 32 px
why: 40 px on a phone is the number this UI already claims
evidence: rail, sort heads, board rows, alert dismiss, LATEST, retry, ticket buttons, clear button and the filter input all clear 40; gate walks every control at 390 px

decision: type below 10 px: the CONTESTED flag at 8 px, chip counts and four label classes at 9 px
why: the overhaul measured contrast but left the size
evidence: every one moves to the 10 px token; gate: no visible text under 10 px

decision: no color-scheme: scrollbars and UA widgets came out light on a dark page
why: cheap and correct
evidence: color-scheme: dark on html; gate reads it back

decision: the machine rows, the berth memory bar, the memory numbers and the telemetry cells were rebuilt on every 3 s poll, so the width transitions they declare never ran
why: a rebuilt element restarts its transition: the gauges jumped every poll
evidence: rows and segments are keyed and updated in place; churn over 7 s fell from 57 nodes to 16 (the log's real arrivals)

decision: the 10 s machine charts rebuilt two line charts whenever the poll read the same window
why: the overhaul's own rule
evidence: owned by a signature like the berth charts; sockets and gauges use setText/ setAttr so identical text is not rewritten

decision: the header rebuilt the conn and state pills and the refusal tally on every poll
why: live regions again, and needless DOM
evidence: a signature guards each; the refusal tally only rebuilds when a reason or count moves

decision: ui.js exported six functions nothing used: hasIcon, closeDialog, emptyNote, csvCell, flash and pulseClass, and two ways to flash a row
why: cruft, and two implementations of one thing
evidence: flash keeps its class only until animationend or the timeout, which is what reduced motion needs; pulseClass is gone; errorNote is now used by the storage panel

decision: extended test/ui/overhaul.py from 57 to 88 checks: poll quiet, live-region ownership, aria state, target sizes at both widths, type floor, chart names, the counter's name, modal key scoping, the failed store read, the node with no host telemetry, the jump button's geometry, the ALL chip's rows and their order, no overflow across eleven widths
why: every claim above needs a check that fails when the behavior is gone
evidence: overhaul.py 88 pass, check.py 75 pass unchanged
